claim: The sample demo starts with three repairs, resets, and never changes the real repair book.
where: landing sample action, demo banner, README
sandbox: create one real repair, enter /demo, change and reset the sample, start for real, then confirm real data is unchanged and demo records were cleared

claim: Works offline after the first visit, including create, edit, and PDF export.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; wait for service worker; go offline; reload, create, edit, and download a PDF
fresh /demo context; inspect the fetched manifest and active service worker

claim: Stores property, repair, and attachment data locally in IndexedDB.
sandbox: fresh /demo context; assert the demo database name, edit a record, reload, and observe persistence
fresh /demo context with no credentials; create a fourth repair through the UI
record every request during a complete ordinary /demo flow and assert all stay on the product origin

claim: Uses no remote fonts or runtime CDN assets.
sandbox: record script, stylesheet, and font requests on /demo; assert same-origin only and no loaded web fonts

claim: Accepts photo or PDF evidence up to 10 MB per file and 50 MB per repair.
sandbox: fresh /demo repair form; assert exact 10 MB and exact 50 MB succeed, then assert both over-limit paths fail

claim: Supports search, due filtering, edit, delete, and a timed undo.
sandbox: fresh /demo data; use every listed control and confirm the deleted record is restored

claim: Creates an on-device evidence PDF with image previews and an attachment index.
sandbox: fresh /demo data; observe the image and evidence index, download the PDF, and validate its bytes

claim: Creates and restores a full JSON backup with original attachment data.
sandbox: fresh /demo data; export, change, restore, and compare the restored attachment bytes

claim: The free book holds five repairs while PDF and JSON export remain free.
sandbox: fresh /demo data; reach five repairs, reject a sixth, then download both export formats

claim: A $24 one-time license enables unlimited repair records.
sandbox: start at /demo; enter a clean real book with a recorded valid verification response and save a sixth repair

claim: A license can be restored on another device, and existing records remain readable after invalidation.
sandbox: fresh browser context from /demo; restore with recorded valid response, then invalidate and read the existing record

claim: Ordinary use sends no product data away; only checkout and license verification use the billing API, and the app receives no card data.
sandbox: record a /demo flow, inspect the checkout URL, intercept one license request, and assert no card fields or request body
